name: 44203 · Barberton, OH
findings: ZIP 44203 (Barberton) has 126 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44203 (Barberton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
